# Triolla – Product UX/UI & AI Design Studio

> Triolla is Israel's #1 product design studio, founded in 2012. We design UX/UI for startups and hi-tech companies in cybersecurity, medtech, fintech, gaming, IoT, SaaS, and AI. 65+ designers. Acquired by SQLink Group.
> Awards: Clutch Top UX Design Company, Calcalist Best UX/UI Agency in Israel, Clutch Global Top 1000.

## Entity Definition

- **Type:** Product UX/UI Design Agency
- **Founded:** 2012 | **Location:** Tel Aviv, Israel | **Team:** 65+ designers & developers
- **Parent company:** SQLink Group
- **Specializations:** Product UX/UI design, AI product design, design systems, branding, frontend & backend development
- **Industries served:** Cybersecurity, Fintech, MedTech, Gaming, SaaS, IoT, AgriTech, B2B Enterprise, B2C, Startups
- **Notable clients:** Armis, Okta, SafeBreach, Plus500, Splitit, Altshuler Shaham, Playtika, Overwolf, Ichilov Hospital, Edwards Lifesciences, Beewise, Netafim
- **Awards:** Clutch Top UX Design Company, Calcalist Best UX/UI Agency in Israel, Clutch Global Top 1000
- **Languages:** English, Hebrew

## Services

- [Product UX/UI Design](/triolla-io-services-product-ux-ui-design.md): End-to-end product design — from UX research and wireframing to high-fidelity UI and design system creation
- [AI & Automation Design](/triolla-io-services-ai-automation.md): UX/UI design for AI-powered products — dashboards, agent interfaces, LLM tools, and automation workflows
- [Design System Creation](/triolla-io-services-design-system-creation.md): Building scalable, reusable component libraries and design tokens for enterprise products
- [UX Research](/triolla-io-services-ux-research.md): User interviews, usability testing, competitive analysis, and persona development
- [Wireframing](/triolla-io-services-wireframing.md): Information architecture and low-fidelity wireframes that define product structure before visual design
- [Prototyping](/triolla-io-services-prototyping.md): Interactive prototypes for user testing, stakeholder presentations, and developer handoff
- [User Testing](/triolla-io-services-user-testing.md): Moderated and unmoderated usability sessions to validate design decisions with real users
- [Motion Design](/triolla-io-services-motion-design.md): Micro-interactions, animated UI components, and motion design for web and mobile products
- [Branding Studio](/triolla-io-branding-studio.md): Brand identity, logo design, visual language, and brand guidelines for tech companies
- [Frontend Development](/triolla-io-services-front-end-dev.md): React, Next.js, and Vue development — pixel-perfect implementation of UX/UI designs
- [Backend Development](/triolla-io-services-back-end-dev.md): Node.js API development and server architecture for complete product builds
- [UI Design](/triolla-io-services-ui-design.md): Visual interface design with focus on aesthetics, accessibility, and brand consistency

- [IoT & Device UX](/triolla-io-device-iot.md): UX for connected devices and smart products — bridging physical hardware with digital dashboards
- [AgriTech UX](/triolla-io-agritech.md): Smart farming platform design for Beewise, SupPlant, Netafim — complex agricultural data made actionable

- [B2C Consumer Apps](/triolla-io-b2c.md): Consumer-facing app design focused on engagement, retention, and intuitive experience
- [Dashboard Design](/triolla-io-dashboard-design.md): Data visualization and enterprise dashboard design for Armis, Okta, Palo Alto, SafeBreach — 100+ dashboards built
